# Phase 01.1: Design System Migration - Discussion Log

> **Audit trail only.** Do not use as input to planning, research, or execution agents.
> Decisions are captured in CONTEXT.md — this log preserves the alternatives considered.

**Date:** 2026-08-04
**Phase:** 01.1-design-system-migration
**Areas discussed:** Brand direction, Diner vocabulary (adopt or author), Scope boundary
**Areas offered but not taken up:** Fold in the parked Phase 01 gaps

---

## Precondition — live re-sync before discussion

At the user's instruction, the design project was re-read live via `DesignSync`
before any gray area was presented. This was load-bearing: the research the phase
was built on (`DESIGN-SYSTEM.md`, 2026-08-02) had gone stale, and two of its
findings would have mis-framed the entire discussion.

| Finding | Effect on the discussion |
|---|---|
| Brand pivoted terracotta → Szeged azure | Became the first gray area rather than an unexamined given |
| B-2 ("diner surface does not exist") resolved by a new `templates/qr-menu/` | Turned "author the diner vocabulary" into "verify then adopt", changing the phase's size |
| D-1 archive never taken | Became a scope-boundary decision (D-12) |
| `.design-sync/config.json` targets a deleted project | Recorded; deferred |

Recorded as a dated delta section at the top of `.planning/research/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md`.

---

## Brand direction

### Q1 — Adopt the Szeged pivot as Cena's product brand?

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Adopt Szeged azure as-is | Fully built, AA-measured, dark mode defined, leans into Hungary — PROJECT.md's sharper wedge. Cost: abandons the original "warm, organic, almost Italian" brief; city heraldry is an odd anchor for EU expansion | ✓ |
| Go back to warm/Italian | Holds the original brief; "Cena" is an Italian/Romanian word and warm-organic travels better across the EU. Cost: re-authoring tokens, 21 guideline cards, dark mode, both templates | |
| Keep the structure, re-hue it | Adopt the architecture (four ramps, 5% accent cap, contrast floor, semantic layer) but swap hues warm | |
| Let me see it first | Render the palette and type specimen cards before deciding | |

**User's choice:** Adopt Szeged azure as-is
**Notes:** Accepts a documented trade-off rather than avoiding it. The EU-expansion awkwardness of a city-heraldry brand was stated in the option and taken knowingly.

### Q2 — How much Cena brand shows on the diner menu?

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Venue colours in Cena's structure | Venue picks palette + font pairing from approved sets; layout/spacing/type scale/interaction fixed. Cena azure absent from the diner surface | ✓ |
| Venue owns it entirely | Wholly the restaurant's brand. Cost: THEME-04 guardrail much harder; visual quality becomes the venue's to break | |
| Cena frames, venue fills | Azure chrome, venue brand inside content. Cost: guaranteed clash for any venue whose brand fights azure | |

**User's choice:** Venue colours in Cena's structure
**Notes:** Matches PROJECT.md's "templates plus guardrailed brand controls" and its explicit exclusion of deep per-venue customization.

### Q3 — How wide is the venue font-pairing choice?

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Small curated set — 3–4 pairings | Self-hosted, subset for RO/HU diacritics, diacritic-verified. Real choice without unbounded payload | ✓ |
| No font choice — colour only | Smallest payload, fastest load. Cost: narrows THEME-02, which names font pairing explicitly | |
| Larger set — 6–8 pairings | More expressive range. Cost: more subsetting, more bytes, more ways to look wrong | |

**User's choice:** Small curated set — 3–4 pairings
**Notes:** A Google Fonts picker was ruled out before asking — ROADMAP SC1 forbids third-party font requests on any page.

### Q4 — Voice, given a deferred-tier lexicon and existing copy debt

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Re-cut lexicon and reconcile the copy deck | Keep the register, re-cut vocabulary to menu-tier words, close the six owed Copywriting Contract rows while in the artifact | ✓ |
| Re-cut the lexicon only | Tighter scope. Cost: the six-row divergence survives into Phase 2 | |
| Keep the lexicon as-is | Defer until the tiers using those words ship. Cost: drift compounds across phases 2–7 | |

**User's choice:** Re-cut lexicon and reconcile the copy deck

## Diner vocabulary — adopt or author

### Q1 — How to treat the qr-menu template's unverified coverage claim

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Verify first, then adopt what holds | Research checks the template against each requirement it names; adopt what holds, author the residue | ✓ |
| Adopt wholesale | Fastest; it was built against real REQUIREMENTS.md. Cost: an unverified claim becomes settled fact for phases 2–7 | |
| Author fresh, use as reference | Most control over the v1 product surface. Cost: largest scope; may redo work that is already right | |

**User's choice:** Verify first, then adopt what holds
**Notes:** Consistent with the standard the Phase 01 roll-up held — a claim is not an observation.

### Q2 — How far does vocabulary work reach (SC5's owner/diner confusion)

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Diner surface + unverified-field marking token | Define the legal-gate state once at token level, not the whole ingestion UI | ✓ |
| Diner surface only | Tightest scope; owner patterns ship with their phases. Cost: narrows SC5 as written | |
| Full I-1 sweep | Complete system for phases 2–7. Cost: most of it designed against code that does not exist | |

**User's choice:** Diner surface + the unverified-field marking token
**Notes:** Surfaced during the question: SC5 lists unverified-AI-field marking as part of the *diner* vocabulary, but it is an owner-side pre-publish concern. Recorded in CONTEXT.md as a ROADMAP wording problem.

### Q3 — What the last-good (DINE-04) state tells the diner

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Timestamped and specific | "Saved menu from 14:20. Prices and sold-out items may have changed." Follows the system's own error rule | ✓ |
| Quiet — just "Saved menu" | Low-anxiety, clean. Cost: cannot distinguish five minutes from five weeks | |
| Prominent warning | Safest on price accuracy. Cost: makes the degraded state feel broken | |

**User's choice:** Timestamped and specific

### Q4 — What a zero-photo menu looks like

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| No image slot at all — typographic layout | A different layout, not the photo layout with holes. Implements PROJECT.md's stated reason directly | ✓ |
| Colour wash per item | One layout across all photo states. Cost: still visibly a slot awaiting an image | |
| Keep the striped placeholder | Cheapest, consistent with the template. Cost: reads as unfinished on a real table | |

**User's choice:** No image slot at all — typographic layout
**Notes:** This overrides the imported template. Surfaced during the question: the template's README claims both that images are "labelled striped placeholders" and that zero-photo is "the design's default, not a degraded mode" — inconsistent. Resolved in favour of PROJECT.md.

## Scope boundary

### Q1 — How much font work lands in 01.1

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Cena's own pairing only; rest with Phase 4 | Satisfies SC1, kills the CDN request, unblocks the diner surface. Venue pairings ship with the theming UI that uses them | ✓ |
| All 3–4 pairings now | One pass while tooling is set up. Cost: three pairings unused until Phase 4, possibly the wrong three | |
| Defer all font work to Phase 2 | Cost: knowingly under-delivers SC1, which names this explicitly | |

**User's choice:** Cena's own pairing only; the rest with Phase 4

### Q2 — Where dark mode applies

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Keep tokens, wire nothing, diner never auto-darks | Dormant tokens cost nothing; locks that the diner menu ignores device dark preference | ✓ |
| Owner admin gets dark mode now | Tokens exist, surfaces being touched anyway. Cost: doubles visual review surface for something no requirement asks for | |
| Strip dark mode out | One less thing to maintain. Cost: discards correct work; re-adding later is dearer | |

**User's choice:** Keep the tokens, wire nothing, diner never auto-darks
**Notes:** The auto-dark prohibition follows from the earlier decision that the diner menu carries the venue's palette — auto-darkening could break THEME-04 contrast, which is measured against the venue's chosen pair.

### Q3 — Correcting the design project's positioning (B-1)

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Fix the readme positioning; leave the kits | Small edit, compounding value — that readme briefs every future /gsd-ui-phase | ✓ |
| Fix readme and re-author the marketing kit | Cost: designs a surface no phase builds; competes with diner vocabulary work | |
| Leave the design project alone | Cleanest repo boundary. Cost: the wrong brief keeps mis-briefing future design passes | |

**User's choice:** Fix the readme positioning; leave the kits
**Notes:** The design project's own `SPEC-VALIDATION.md` already concedes the back-office kit "builds a different product than Cena v1", corroborating B-1 from inside the project.

### Q4 — The two risk items

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Take the archive now; defer the sync tooling | ~9 reads removes a single point of failure; sync direction decided once new primitives exist | ✓ |
| Take the archive and repoint .design-sync | Cost: commits to a sync direction before the component layer exists | |
| Retire .design-sync, take the archive | Cost: loses the round-trip that produced the design project's previews | |
| Neither — not this phase | Cost: archive stays unguarded behind a deletable project | |

**User's choice:** Take the archive now; defer the sync tooling

## Claude's Discretion

None. Every area presented was decided explicitly by the user. Mechanisms named
inside decisions (subsetting approach, contrast-guardrail enforcement) were left
to research and planning rather than to discretion.

## Deferred Ideas

- Venue font pairings 2–4 → Phase 4
- Dark-mode UI → unscheduled; tokens kept dormant
- Marketing site re-author → no phase builds one
- `.design-sync` repoint-vs-retire → after the new primitive layer exists
- A real logo / wordmark → unscoped; "Cena" is type-only in Newsreader
- THEME-04 contrast-guardrail enforcement mechanism → Phase 4 or 01.1 research
- Owner-side patterns: per-language authoring (LANG-01..04), QR print sheet (DINE-01) → their own phases

## Not Decided

**Whether the parked Phase 01 gaps (G-01-13, G-01-14) are folded into the 01.1
re-skin plans.** Offered twice as a gray area, not taken up. Carried into
CONTEXT.md as an explicit open question for the planner, with the audit's own
sequencing note attached — that note argues for folding, and the planner is asked
to surface the choice rather than make it silently.
